I bought this chair for my deer stand, and overall, I’m happy with it. It’s comfortable to sit in, and the swivel moves smoothly and quietly. The adjustable design makes it easy to find the best position for viewing deer. The only improvement I’d suggest is a backrest that reclines a little farther for added comfort. Overall, it’s a solid hunting chair that gets the job done

I use this beautiful canner to store pounds of wild bird seed in my house. It's effective against rodents and unlike plastic, it will not contaminate the seed.

Great water bath canner. A great size which has allowed me to reduce my time spend canning by increasing the amount of jars I can can at one time. I have had to make a few modifications. I have added rubber washers to the handles as when operating at capacity the water is leaking out of the handles. I have also added a drain tap on the side to allow me to drain the caner without having to lift it full of water to tip it out. I have noticed a few spots of rust appear in the corners after only 4 uses. But overall for the money it is a great canner.

Good quality for the price! Definitely worth it for me. I can fit twice as many cans in this one compared to the old one I used. Only downside is I did notice it scratched easily on the inside so when taking the accessories out just be careful. Easy to clean, I just wiped it down once it was cooled off. Heat distribution is even & great!
